decisions.reason: Crew and corporate travel management sits right next to the core crewing business, costs little to run, and supports the firm's goal of a broader service scope, so with an expanding firm and growing industry it is unlikely to fall below aspiration enough to trigger problemistic search.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital offer that ties customers closely to the firm, and slack from the expanding business lets management carry it while its results are still uncertain.

The mobile performance app is a riskier, non-flagship digital add-on that could be folded into the portal if results disappoint, but it fits the sustainability and efficiency direction and there is no clear evidence of a shortfall that would force a withdrawal.
